point: Humanity is currently experiencing unprecedented historical levels of health, wealth, and opportunity.
quote: this is the greatest time there's ever been on this planet by any measure you wish to choose

point: Scientific problem-solving and modern medicine have eradicated deadly diseases and transformed human life expectancy.
quote: vaccines modern medicine our ability to feed billions of people those are triumphs of the scientific method

point: While people are entitled to hold their own opinions, they are not entitled to create their own facts.
quote: they're even entitled to their opinion about progress but you know what you're not entitled to you're not entitled to your own facts

point: Healthy skepticism is vital, but individuals must be willing to accept findings when proof and evidence are provided.
quote: ask questions demand proof demand evidence don't take anything for granted but here's the thing when you get proof you need to accept the proof

point: Extensive international scientific research found no link between vaccines and autism, yet emotional anecdotes continue to mislead people.
quote: the data came back from the united states from england from sweden from canada and it was all the same no correlation no connection

point: Refusing vaccinations threatens public health by inviting the swift re-emergence of preventable and debilitating diseases.
quote: vaccines are essential you take them away disease comes back horrible diseases and that's happening we have measles in this country now

point: Distrust in existing medical institutions often drives people to spend billions of dollars on completely ineffective alternative treatments.
quote: they take alternative medicines and it doesn't matter how often we find out that they're useless the data says it all the time

point: Discarding evidence-based science in favor of unproven beliefs can produce catastrophic and lethal consequences.
quote: when you start down the road where belief and magic replace evidence and science you end up in a place you don't want to be

point: Virtually all crops consumed today were selectively bred by humans, and modern genetic modification can deliver life-saving nutrition.
quote: every single thing we eat every grain of rice every sprig of parsley every brussel sprout has been modified by man

point: Blocking agricultural biotechnology that can alleviate severe malnutrition and food shortages in developing regions is a harmful form of high-tech colonialism.
quote: we're guilty of something that i don't think we want to be guilty of high tech colonialism there's no other way to describe what's going on
